```{r load_libraries, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(ggpubr)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)
library(data.table)
theme_set(theme_classic())

data_dir   = "~/research/data/TCR/TCGA/_processed_data"
result_dir = "~/research/data/TCR/TCGA/_results"

```

# Read in data

## Read in somatic mutations 

There are three list
1. all muations that appear at least 5 times
2. those mutations ranked by the number of associated TCRs
3. those identified by cross-validation

```{r}
cv_fnm = "cv_optimal_pcut_both_uniq_mutations.tsv"
mut_data   = fread(file.path(data_dir, "mutation_info.tsv"))

mut_data[,mutation := paste(Hugo_Symbol, gsub("p.", "", HGVSp_Short), sep = ":")]
dim(mut_data)
mut_data[1:2,]

table(mut_data$Freq >= 5)

mut_by_TCR = fread(file.path(result_dir, "step8_mutation_by_nTCR.tsv"))

dim(mut_by_TCR)
mut_by_TCR[1:2,]

table(mut_by_TCR$mutation %in% mut_data$mutation)
setdiff(mut_by_TCR$mutation, mut_data$mutation)

mut_by_TCR = merge(mut_by_TCR, mut_data)
dim(mut_by_TCR)
mut_by_TCR[1:2,]

mut_by_cv  = fread(file.path(result_dir, "_cross_validation", cv_fnm))

dim(mut_by_cv)
mut_by_cv[1:2,]

sort(mut_by_cv$key_pro)
table(mut_by_cv$key_pro %in% mut_by_TCR$mutation)

mut_by_TCR[, nTCR := nTCRA + nTCRB]
mut_by_TCR[, in_cv := mutation %in% mut_by_cv$key_pro]

wilcox.test(nTCR ~ in_cv, data = mut_by_TCR)
```


## Read in known neoantigens

```{r}
known_neoantigen = fread("../data/konwn_public_neoantigen.csv")
dim(known_neoantigen)
known_neoantigen[1:2,]

uniq_neo_mutations = unique(known_neoantigen$key)
length(uniq_neo_mutations)

known_neoantigen[,mutation := gsub(":p.", ":", key, fixed = TRUE)]

table(mut_by_cv$key_pro %in% known_neoantigen$mutation)
table(mut_by_cv$key_pro %in% mut_by_TCR$mutation)

table(mut_by_TCR$mutation %in% known_neoantigen$mutation)
table(mut_by_TCR$mutation %in% known_neoantigen$mutation, mut_by_TCR$nTCRA > 30)
table(mut_by_TCR$mutation %in% known_neoantigen$mutation, mut_by_TCR$nTCRB > 10)

tb0 = table(mut_by_TCR$mutation %in% mut_by_cv$key_pro, 
            mut_by_TCR$nTCRA > 30 & mut_by_TCR$nTCRB > 10)

tb1 = table(mut_by_TCR$mutation %in% known_neoantigen$mutation, 
            mut_by_TCR$nTCRA > 30 & mut_by_TCR$nTCRB > 10)

tb2 = table(mut_by_TCR$mutation %in% known_neoantigen$mutation, 
            mut_by_TCR$nTCRA > 40 & mut_by_TCR$nTCRB > 20)

c0 = chisq.test(tb0)
c1 = chisq.test(tb1)
c2 = chisq.test(tb2)

c0$expected
c0$observed

c1$expected
c1$observed

c2$expected
c2$observed

c0
c1
c2

tapply(mut_by_TCR$Freq, mut_by_TCR$nTCRA > 30 & mut_by_TCR$nTCRB > 10, summary)
tapply(mut_by_TCR$Freq, mut_by_TCR$nTCRA > 30 & mut_by_TCR$nTCRB > 10, 
       function(v){table(v > 20)})

tapply(mut_by_TCR$Freq, mut_by_TCR$mutation %in% known_neoantigen$mutation, 
       function(v){table(v > 20)})

mut_by_TCR[,neoantigen := mut_by_TCR$mutation %in% known_neoantigen$mutation]

fit <- lm(log10(nTCR)  ~  neoantigen + log10(Freq),
           data = mut_by_TCR)
summary(fit)
```

```{r fig.width = 4.5, fig.height = 3}
mut_by_TCR20 = mut_by_TCR[Freq > 20,]
dim(mut_by_TCR20)
mut_by_TCR20[1:2,]

table(mut_by_TCR20$Freq > 100)
# create frequency group variable
mut_by_TCR20 <- mut_by_TCR20 %>%
  mutate(FreqGroup = ifelse(Freq > 100, "Freq > 100", "Freq ≤ 100"))

p <- ggplot(mut_by_TCR20, aes(x = FreqGroup, 
                              y = log10(nTCRA + nTCRB), 
                              fill = neoantigen)) +
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA, alpha = 0.7, position = position_dodge(width = 0.7)) +
  geom_jitter(position = position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.2, dodge.width = 0.7),
              alpha = 0.5, size = 1) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("FALSE" = "grey70", "TRUE" = "red"),
                    labels = c("No", "Yes")) +
  labs(
    x = "Frequency group",
    y = "log10(nTCRA + nTCRB)",
    fill = "Neoantigen"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  stat_compare_means(aes(group = neoantigen), 
                     method = "wilcox.test", 
                     label = "p.format", 
                     label.y = max(log10(mut_by_TCR20$nTCRA + mut_by_TCR20$nTCRB)) - 0.02)

print(p)

ggplot(mut_by_TCR20, aes(x = log10(Freq), y = log10(nTCRA + nTCRB), 
                         color = neoantigen)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.8, size = 2) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, color = "black", linetype = "dashed") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("FALSE" = "grey70", "TRUE" = "red")) +
  labs(
    x = "log10(Frequency)",
    y = "log10(nTCRA + nTCRB)",
    color = "Neoantigen"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 14)

```
